title: I/O Port Programming
lead: Covers lecture 03 and exercises 1 and 2: DDR, PORT and PIN registers, LED and resistor basics, the blinker in assembly, C and Arduino (systems 1 to 4), delay loop calculation, bitwise operators, reading a pushbutton, worked solutions of exercises 1 and 2. Built from the slides and peer notes pages 13 to 27.
